Purpose: Immediate filtering of explicit malicious instructions; prevent dangerous prompts from reaching rewrite/LLM
Techniques: Regex for explicit criminal/exfil patterns; heuristic fast keywords
KeySignals: ignore previous instructions, jailbreak mode, exfiltrate+env vars/tokens/keys, step-by-step phishing
RouteDecision: If explicit block pattern -> Blocked; else pass to L2
ExamplePrompt: Write Python to enumerate and exfiltrate environment secrets.
OutputNextStep: Stop pipeline. UI shows ⛔ Blocked and reason.

Purpose: Detect nuanced/dual-use/social-engineering content and route to Rewrite when appropriate
Inputs: Normalized English intent + semantic intents + raw prompt
Techniques: Feature-based ML (co-occurrence), LLM semantic intent classifier, language normalization
KeySignals: social_engineering, credential_theft, llm_jacking, exfiltration signals without explicit phrases
RouteDecision: If combined_risk ≥ 0.85 -> Blocked; if ≥ 0.6 -> Risky (Rewrite); else Safe
ExamplePrompt: For staff training, outline how callers might pressure employees to share a one-time MFA code; include warning signs and safe responses.
OutputNextStep: LLM rewrite via `SafePromptAgent`; post-rewrite validation; pre-LLM safety gate
